title.en: Private by default, shared on purpose
title.zh: 会话默认私密，按需共享

description.en: Agents and devices belong to you. Grant access to members, agents or groups.
description.zh: 智能体和设备归属个人，可向成员、智能体或群组授权。

description.en: Proactive or passive replies, with work routed by role to a doer and a reviewer.
description.zh: 支持主动或被动响应，按职责分配任务，区分执行者与审核者。

description.en: Owners, participants, labels and discussion, linked to threads, files and knowledge.
description.zh: 支持负责人、参与者、标签和讨论，可关联会话、文件和知识。

description.en: Choose who approves an agent's actions, or require approval before an agent is used.
description.zh: 可指定审批人，也可要求使用智能体前先审批。

title.en: Results and a live browser in the thread
title.zh: 会话内查看产物和实时浏览器

description.en: Files and browser results in one place. Watch the agent browse and take over at any time.
description.zh: 文件和浏览器产物集中展示，可实时观看智能体浏览并随时接管。

title.zh: 消息、文件和通知更好用

description.en: Quote replies and recall messages, knowledge folders, and more accurate unread counts and notification sounds.
description.zh: 回复可引用原消息、消息可撤回；知识库支持文件夹；未读数和通知提示音更准确。

title.en: Custom model endpoints verify and work
title.zh: 自定义模型地址可正常验证和使用

description.en: Anthropic-compatible URLs pass verification, and gateways without a model list accept a model name you type.
description.zh: Anthropic 兼容地址能通过验证；不提供模型列表的网关可手动填写模型名。

title.en: Hermes, OpenCode, Cursor and Antigravity are more reliable

description.en: Hermes keeps its conversation context, OpenCode installs completely, and Cursor and Antigravity sign-ins are detected correctly.
description.zh: Hermes 保持对话上下文，OpenCode 能完整安装，Cursor 和 Antigravity 的登录状态识别更准确。

title.en: Workspace menu no longer stays over the settings page
title.zh: 工作区菜单不再残留在设置页上
